evidence: Recorded observations only. Original world coordinates, destination/account identities, machine paths and wall clock are omitted.
timeBasis: Seconds since the manual Journey request; frame numbers and epochs are relative to that request.
coordinateBasis: One rigid translation places departure opening 0 at (0,0,0). The same translation is applied to every camera, aim and projection centre. The original offset is omitted.
limitations: Carrier transforms were not recorded. Camera positions cannot be asserted to be carrier positions.
No containing foliage-bound identity, extent, triangle or alpha texture is present. The historical containment verdict is not proof of leaf penetration.
Resolved graph-edge records omit parent identity and original required seam. They do not reconstruct a complete navigable world or graph.
Projection requested positions can belong to another probe when a scan commits. No probe ownership is invented for those projection rows.
No candidate was admitted; this fixture cannot demonstrate a successful Journey or native route validation.

selection.allCounts: Computed over all three scenic JSONL parts; projection counts cover projection 2 from the request onward.
selection.edgeExamples: First 12 resolved edge events per batch, furthest clear endpoint per batch, and last 3 events per batch; duplicate sequences removed.
selection.observationSequence: All query-15 Journey view rows and projection-2 rows in the two listed request-relative intervals, ordered by original source sequence. Repeated reason text is represented by the recorded typed status and flags; numeric observations are unchanged.
selection.cameraExamples: Nearest captured sample at request, second-batch beginning, ordinary shot change and end of evidence.
selection.bodyContainmentExamples: All three gaze evaluations for the first blocked graph edge (query15,probe5).
